target: AI Hub synthetic anomaly labels; immediate and delayed closed-window tasks evaluated separately
hypothesis_origin: Includes previously inspected2024 error analysis; no claim of a blind2024 evaluation
fold_rules: Fit every available earlier labeled row from both source partitions; no row sampling
Never split a transaction date or three-hour bucket across fit and development
Use only earlier-date history and earlier completed buckets for immediate features
Use current-bucket peers only for the separately declared delayed task
Fit mappings, weights, preprocessing and models on the fold's past only
Record a missing or unseen subtype; do not remove its transactions or report it as evaluated
Every candidate uses the same fold populations and original label prevalence

first_experiment.features: Existing server-reproducible86 closed-window features; no identifiers or labels in inference input
first_experiment.execution_unit: One configuration and one temporal fold per work segment; compare with fold-fitted references before further fitting
first_experiment.selection: Reject a naive OR promotion; joint alert policy must be fixed from pre2024 out-of-fold scores before full-past refit

selection_rule.threshold_data: Pre2024 temporal out-of-fold predictions only; never predictions of a model fitted on those development rows
selection_rule.candidate_order: Among policies passing the precision, overall recall, per-type recall and alert-budget constraints, maximize recall; break ties by fewer false alerts
selection_rule.if_no_candidate_passes: Report target failure and continue an explicit development experiment; do not relax the target silently or promote a fallback
selection_rule.coverage_limit: Subgroups with zero positives or too few examples cannot establish reliable detection performance; report counts and intervals

evaluation.previously_inspected2024: Retrospective diagnostics only; no threshold search, parameter search or automatic promotion
evaluation.independent_future_data: Not available in the verified local sources; do not relabel a reused split as blind
evaluation.evidence_required_for_operational_claim: Independent future labels, confirmed runtime input coverage and actual service validation
